CameraModuleData.description: Settings for the camera module, which layers the player's camera view into the game.

enabled.description: Whether the module is switched on for this game.

preview.description: Whether the webcam preview shows. Defaults to `true`.

GameAfterTrigger.description: Once, some time after the display is shown.

after.description: Milliseconds after the display is shown: a number, or an expression.

GameAnimationEndTrigger.description: A CSS animation ending on an element of the display.

GameAnswerAction.description: Submits an answer to this display's challenge, checked as a typed answer is. Challenge displays only.

GameChallengeData.description: Describes an individual challenge in the game

displays.description: Displays for this challenge, chosen by purpose: title, in progress, and completed.

id.description: Unique id for this challenge, used when submitting and checking answers.

solution.description: How the player's answer is checked for this challenge.

GameChallengeDisplay.description: A display for one stage of a challenge's lifecycle.

camera.description: Camera mode settings for this display, falling back to broader displays.

resetDisplay.description: Shown in this display's place first, to help the player get ready for it, until one of its rules finishes it.

GameChallengeDisplayPurpose.description: What a challenge display is for: its title, while in progress, or once completed.

GameChallengeSolution.description: Information about how to respond to a user's game challenge answer

answers.description: One or more valid solutions for this challenge

ignoreCase.description: Solutions can be matched ignoring case, default: true

ignoreWhitespace.description: Solutions can be matched ignoring whitespace, default: true

trimWhitespace.description: Solutions can be matched ignoring leading and trailing whitespace, default: true

GameCompleteChallengeAction.description: Marks this display's challenge as solved. Challenge displays only.

GameData.description: A game's authored definition: its overview displays, stages, challenges, resources and settings.

autoAdvanceStages.description:
Whether to move on to the next stage automatically on completion.
Not yet implemented: never read. See docs/prompts/000.00.02.feedback - fixes from identified bugs and tests.md #3.

sequential.description: If true (the default when `config` is omitted), each stage unlocks only after the previous one is completed.

credits.description: Credits for the third-party media this game uses, listed with the game on the landing page.

text.description: What to show, e.g. the work's title and author.

url.description: Where to link the text to, if anywhere.

description.description: One-line description, shown on the game's tile on the landing page.

displays.description: Overview displays (title, stages, complete), shown when no stage is active.

gameContainerStyle.description: CSS applied to the element containing the whole game, e.g. fonts, colours and sizing.

modules.description: Optional modules to switch on for this game.

camera.description: Layers the player's camera view into the game.

resources.description: Named media resources, referenced by `*Resource` keys and passed to templates as `resources`.

reward.description: The celebration shown when a stage is completed. Unset means none.

sounds.description: Music and sound effects, as resource names (keys of `resources`). Any left unset is silent.

closingMusicResource.description: Music played on the game-complete overview.

openingMusicResource.description: Music played when the stages overview shows.

stageCompletedSoundResource.description: Sound effect played when a stage is completed.

stageOpenedSoundResource.description: Sound effect played when a stage opens.

stages.description: The stages of the game, in order.

stylesheets.description:
Names of resources (keys of `resources`) that are CSS stylesheets the game needs, such as a web font;
loaded while the game is shown. Only `https:` or same-site URLs are used.

tileGraphic.description: Resource name (a key of `resources`) of the image shown behind the game's landing-page tile.

title.description: Name of the game, shown to players when choosing a game.

GameDisplayCameraData.description: Camera mode settings for one display; unset fields fall back to broader displays.

enabled.description: Whether camera mode is on while this display shows.

preview.description: Whether the webcam preview shows while this display shows.

GameDisplayComponentData.description: The rendering definition of a display, discriminated by `type`.

GameDisplayDialogComponentData.description: A paged display on a background image of the game's choosing, scaled to fit, with the text kept inside its margins.

backgroundStyle.description: CSS for the background layer's container.

backgroundTemplate.description: Template for the background layer, drawn behind the game's other content.

backgroundTemplateStyle.description: CSS for the element wrapping the rendered background template.

contents.description: The pages, shown one at a time in order.

data.description: Extra values for this display, passed through to its templates as `data` (and `componentData`).

foregroundStyle.description: CSS for the foreground layer's container: the column the pages are shown in.

foregroundTemplate.description: Template for each page in the foreground layer, drawn in front of the game's other content.

foregroundTemplateStyle.description: CSS for the element wrapping the rendered foreground template.

imageMargins.description: Where the text sits on the image. Defaults to no margin.

imageResource.description: Resource name of the background image. Without one, the dialog fills its display.

initialState.description: The display's state when it is first shown, and after a reset. Templates and rules see it as `state`.

resetStateOnShow.description: Whether state returns to `initialState` each time the display is shown. Defaults to false.

rules.description: What happens in response to events, in order.

type.description: Which kind of component this is.

GameDisplayDialogMargins.description:
Space to leave between each edge of a dialog's image and its text, as CSS percentages of the image's
height (top, bottom) or width (left, right), e.g. `"12%"`. Use it to keep text off transparent or decorative edges.

bottom.description: From the image's bottom edge, as a percentage of its height.

left.description: From the image's left edge, as a percentage of its width.

right.description: From the image's right edge, as a percentage of its width.

top.description: From the image's top edge, as a percentage of its height.

GameDisplayMediaData.description: Media played with a display. Resources are names defined in the game's `resources`.

audioDescription.description: Accessible description of the audio, for screen readers. Default: "audio".

motionImageResource.description: Resource name of an image shown while the audio is playing.

resource.description: Resource name of the audio file.

stillImageResource.description: Resource name of an image shown while the audio is not playing.

type.description: The kind of media: only audio is supported.

GameDisplayPageData.description: One page of a paged display.

label.description: Label for the answer input. Used only when `showInput` is true.

media.description: Audio to play on this page.

showInput.description: If true, shows an answer input on this page.

GameDisplayScrollComponentData.description: A dialog on the app's old-paper image: see {@link GameDisplayPagedComponentBase} for its fields.

backgroundStyle.description: CSS for the background layer's container.

backgroundTemplate.description: Template for the background layer, drawn behind the game's other content.

backgroundTemplateStyle.description: CSS for the element wrapping the rendered background template.

contents.description: The pages, shown one at a time in order.

data.description: Extra values for this display, passed through to its templates as `data` (and `componentData`).

foregroundStyle.description: CSS for the foreground layer's container: the column the pages are shown in.

foregroundTemplate.description: Template for each page in the foreground layer, drawn in front of the game's other content.

foregroundTemplateStyle.description: CSS for the element wrapping the rendered foreground template.

initialState.description: The display's state when it is first shown, and after a reset. Templates and rules see it as `state`.

resetStateOnShow.description: Whether state returns to `initialState` each time the display is shown. Defaults to false.

rules.description: What happens in response to events, in order.

type.description: Which kind of component this is.

GameDisplayTemplateComponentData.description: A display built from Handlebars templates, drawn as a background layer and a foreground layer.

backgroundStyle.description: CSS for the background layer's container.

backgroundTemplate.description: Template for the background layer, drawn behind the game's other content.

backgroundTemplateStyle.description: CSS for the element wrapping the rendered background template.

data.description: Extra values for this display, passed through to its templates as `data` (and `componentData`).

foregroundStyle.description: CSS for the foreground layer's container.

foregroundTemplate.description: Template for the foreground layer, drawn in front of the game's other content.

foregroundTemplateStyle.description: CSS for the element wrapping the rendered foreground template.

initialState.description: The display's state when it is first shown, and after a reset. Templates and rules see it as `state`.

resetStateOnShow.description: Whether state returns to `initialState` each time the display is shown. Defaults to false.

rules.description: What happens in response to events, in order.

type.description: Which kind of component this is.

GameDisplayTemplateSourceData.description: Says where to find a template's text.

content.description: The template text itself. Used only when `sourceType` is `embedded`.

sourceType.description: How `templateSource` is resolved, or `embedded` to use `content`.

templateSource.description: Path or URL of the template, interpreted according to `sourceType`. Unused for `embedded`.

GameEnterStageAction.description: Opens a stage, unless it is locked or completed.

GameEveryTrigger.description: Repeatedly, while the display is shown.

every.description: Milliseconds between firings: a number, or an expression re-evaluated each time.

GameFinishResetAction.description: Finishes this reset display, revealing the display it is shown for. Reset displays only.

GameInteractTrigger.description: A player (or a click) interacting with an element of the display.

includeCovered.description: Camera interactions only: also fire when the element is covered by another element. Defaults to false.

interact.description: The interactions that fire the rule.

target.description: CSS selector for the elements, eg. `#door` or `.lava`.

threshold.description: Camera interactions only: the fraction of the body part that must be inside the element (0–1). Defaults to 1.

GameOverviewDisplay.description: A display shown when no stage is active.

camera.description: Camera mode settings for this display, falling back to broader displays.

resetDisplay.description: Shown in this display's place first, to help the player get ready for it, until one of its rules finishes it.

GameOverviewDisplayPurpose.description: What an overview display is for: the title screen, the stage selection, or the game-complete screen.

GameResetChallengeAction.description: Clears this display's challenge, and the state of its displays. Challenge displays only.

GameResetDisplay.description: A display that helps the player get ready for its parent display, eg. "Return to the start".

camera.description: Camera mode settings while it shows, over its parent's.

component.description: How this display is rendered, and the rules that finish it (`finishReset`).

resetDisplay.description: A reset display for this reset display, shown before it.

showOn.description:
When it shows: before its parent is first shown since the game loaded (the default), or before every showing.
It always shows again when its parent's challenge is reset. A nested reset display shows with this one.

target.description: The path or URL, interpreted according to `type`.

type.description: `local`: path on this site. `relative`: relative to the repository's location. `url`: absolute URL used as-is.

GameResourceDefinitions.description:
Named resources, keyed by the name used to refer to them.
Resolved to absolute URLs when the game loads.

GameRule.description: One behaviour: when the trigger fires and the condition holds, apply the actions in order.

do.description: What the rule does, in order.

if.description: The rule is skipped when this expression is false.

GameSetAction.description: Sets state keys to the values of expressions, all evaluated against the state before the action.

GameStageData.description:
Describes a game stage - including its displays, and the challenges it contains.
A stage may contain more than one challenge, and may group its challenges together.

challengeChunking.description: How many challenges to show together at once in the stage layout. Default: 1.

challenges.description: The challenges in this stage, in the order they are presented.

displays.description: Displays shown behind this stage's challenges (purpose `shared`). Optional.

id.description: Unique id for this stage, referenced by `enterStage` actions in display rules.

GameStageDisplay.description: A display shared by all challenges in a stage.

camera.description: Camera mode settings for this display, falling back to broader displays.

resetDisplay.description: Shown in this display's place first, to help the player get ready for it, until one of its rules finishes it.

GameTransitionEndTrigger.description: A CSS transition ending on an element of the display.

GameWhenTrigger.description: An expression turning from false to true.

when.description: Fires on each change from false to true, after any state or game change.

RewardAnimation.description:
The partycles animations a reward can use. Declared here rather than imported from partycles
because the schema generator can't resolve that package; keep in step with its `AnimationType`.

TemplateSourceType.description:
Where a template is read from: `local` (path on this site), `relative` (relative to the repository's location),
`url` (absolute URL, fetched as-is) or `embedded` (text inline in `content`).

description: A collection of games, keyed by id. This is the top level of a game repository JSON file.

error.description: Runtime-only message, set by the provider if loading failed. Not authored.

games.description: The games in this repository, keyed by {@link GameId}.

loading.description: Runtime-only flag, set by the provider while the repository is being fetched. Not authored.

ready.description: Runtime-only flag, set by the provider once loading has succeeded. Not authored.
